[[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|Penny]]'s 14 Heart Event (1) }} The '''Stove Fireplace''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be purchased for {{Price|3000}} from the [[Carpenter's Shop]] any day that it is open. It cannot be purchased from the [[Furniture Catalogue]]. One can be found in the repaired [[Island Farmhouse]]. One can also be acquired during [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|Penny]]'s 14 Heart Event by choosing the "Pirate Theme". [[Furniture#Fireplaces|Fireplaces]] cannot be placed outside.
